title: PWKUtils
description: PWKUtils is a serverside utility mod that aims to provide easy access to custom join and leave messages, motds, tablists and more!
body:
## Features
### Player Prefixes
- Automatically assigns prefixes to players based on OP status
- Prefixes are configurable in the config.json
- Prefixes update live if a player is OPed or de-opped

### Chat Formatting
- Customizable chat format
- Option to enable/disable formatting via config

### Join/Leave Messages
- Custom join and leave messages
- Messages can include player names using {player}
- Can be toggled on/off in the config

### Welcome Message
- Sends a configurable welcome message when a player joins
- Can be toggled on/off in the config
- Optionally supports multi-line messages using \n

### Tablist Customization
- Custom header and footer for the tablist
- Shows online players if enabled in the config
- Updates every second
  
### Auto-Whitelist
- Whitelist multiple players at once
- Use /autowhitelist <add|list|clear> to create a list of players
- Use /autowhitelist run to whitelist all players on the auto whitelist.

### Commands
- /gm <0-3> – Quickly change your game mode:
0 = Survival,
1 = Creative,
2 = Adventure,
3 = Spectator
> You can also give other players gamemode, using /gm <0-3> <playername>
 
- /tps – Displays the current server TPS

## Localization
Customize all messages of this mod in the messages.json and the config!

## Planned
- Custom MotD
- /day, /night commands
